title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI hooks and quality gating enhancements
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: our per-prompt regression checks have been too coarse for mixed-quality prompt-sets. This PR enhances the eval-harness CI hooks to run per-prompt metrics, apply configurable per-prompt thresholds and weightings, and surface a concise PR summary that explains which prompt families regressed and why. Goals: reduce noisy failures, surface high-impact regressions, make gating flexible for teams with different risk tolerances.

What this changes: added a new per-prompt evaluation pipeline (ci/prompt-regression-hook.py) that computes per-prompt and aggregated metrics, applies thresholds defined in configs/per_prompt_thresholds.yaml, and posts a structured summary comment to the PR. Introduces per-prompt weighting so low-importance prompts don't block merges when high-importance prompts are stable. Adds a PR-side reporter (reports/pr-eval-summarizer.py) used by the hook and by manual evaluators. Integrates the hook into the existing GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/eval-ci.yml) so the per-prompt job runs in parallel with existing end-to-end eval jobs.

Backward compatibility and rollout: defaults are conservative and mirror current global thresholds; feature is enabled by default for eval-harness-owned routes. Ops can override via per-repo config (see configs/README). Added a feature flag EVAL_PER_PROMPT_GATING to gate rollout to Dedicated accounts if we want a staged rollout.

Testing: added unit and integration tests (tests/test_per_prompt_hook.py) with mocked metrics backend. Added a small real-run smoke test that runs on a subset of the prompt-set to verify stability in CI. All tests pass locally and in CI except for one intermittent integration flake that was rerun.

Checklist: 
- [x] Implement per-prompt metrics computation and aggregation
- [x] Add per-prompt thresholds and weighting config
- [x] Integrate into GitHub Actions and ensure job parallelism
- [x] Add unit/integration tests and documentation
- [x] Post human-readable PR summary comment and link to detailed report

Related: ENG-4123 (per-prompt quality gates), ENG-4281 (CI flakiness reductions), SUP-2217 (customer incident motivating stricter prompt-level checks).
